hotels.title: China Luxury Golf Resort in Haikou with 10 Championship Courses, Three Complimentary Rounds of Golf & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Set on lush volcanic terrain just north of Haikou, this sprawling resort offers direct access to an impressive golf complex, where championship courses wind through striking black lava rock. After a morning on the fairways, soak in the region’s famed mineral hot springs, complete with 168 hot and cold pools, unwind in sprawling lazy river, lagoon and pools, or relax at the soothing Mission Hills Spa, offering healing methods that will make you feel worlds away. Taste your way through various onsite dining options. Silver Moon Restaurant brings authentic Canton and Hainan flavours to your table, Ukiyo Japanese Restaurant offers authentic sushi and barbecued dishes and The Onyx Restaurant and Lounge is where sophisticated interiors and relaxed dining combine. With Mission Hills Centreville’s shops and Haikou Volcanic Cluster Global Geopark nearby, each day promises new discoveries and local culture at your doorstep.
